name: Korean Cup Noodles
ingredients_raw: Instant Noodles: Whole Wheat Flour (Atta), Refined Rice Bran Oil, lodized Salt, Starch, Wheat Gluten, Potassium Chloride, Stabilizer (INS 508, INS 412), Humectant (INS 451 (i), Acidity Regulators (INS 500 8 (i), INS 501 (i)). Seasoning Mix: Salt, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein, Spices (Chilli, Pepper), Pre Gel Starch, Soya Sauce Powder, Potato Starch, Flavour Enhancers (E 621, E 635), Vegetable Powder & Flakes (Onion, Garlic, Tomato, Mushroom, Cabbage, Carrot, Green Onion), Sugar, Acidity Regulator (E330), Edible Vegetable Oil, Anticaking Agent (E 551). CONTAINS NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES. CONTAINS MONO SODIUM GLUTAMATE. ALLERGENS: THIS PRODUCT IS MANUFACTURED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES INGREDIENTS CONTAINING MILK, SOY AND GROUNDNUTS. Not recommended for infants below 12 months and pregnant women. GUILT-FREE INDULGENCE. PINKY PROMISE. Never
